table setting context. All formats include proper fold lines and assembly guidelines for easy production."},{"question":"What file formats will I receive for my restaurant table tents?","answer":"You'll receive your table tent designs in print-ready formats optimized for professional production—including high-resolution PDF files with proper bleed areas, cut lines, and fold marks; editable design files for any required modifications or content updates for future promotions; and assembly instructions that ensure proper display construction for your specific tabletop format."},{"question":"How often should I change my table tent promotions?","answer":"The optimal rotation schedule depends on your specific restaurant type and customer visit frequency.
